flowContents.name: PG7 Open-Meteo LAB
flowContents.comments: Open-Meteo LAB alternative (not official AEMET). One HTTP hourly forecast -> actual local S3 Bronze/Silver/Parquet Gold -> Mongo. Runtime verified 2026-10-02. Components disabled for safe import; configure sensitive LAB params before enabling.

processors.name: Preserve failed payloads in LAB folder
Gold Parquet records to LAB Mongo
Silver typed JSON to LAB S3
Gold real Parquet to LAB S3
Bronze raw JSON to LAB S3
One HTTP request per manual run

properties.gold:
SELECT municipio, provider, data_kind, timezone, source_url, fetched_at_utc, source_object,
 MIN(timestamp_utc) AS start_utc, MAX(timestamp_utc) AS end_utc,
 COUNT(*) AS n_hours, COUNT(DISTINCT timestamp_utc) AS n_distinct_hours,
 AVG(temperatura_c) AS temperatura_media_c, MIN(temperatura_c) AS temperatura_min_c,
 MAX(temperatura_c) AS temperatura_max_c, AVG(humedad_pct) AS humedad_media_pct
 FROM FLOWFILE GROUP BY municipio, provider, data_kind, timezone, source_url, fetched_at_utc, source_object
